buildings.name: Outpost
buildings.effect: Claims territory; +supply range; small garrison. (Neutral Zone outposts, cast rodinium)

buildings.name: Deep Space Station
buildings.effect: Trade hub (+Latinum), repairs, docking for 4 ships. (K-7)

buildings.name: Starbase
buildings.effect: Heavy defense, fleet command aura, research, supply range 3.

buildings.name: Spacedock
buildings.effect: Builds hulls ≤ size 6 inside its bay; full repairs; Earth Spacedock 'mushroom'.

buildings.name: Yorktown-type Megastation
buildings.effect: Massive population, research and trade; a world in a snow globe.

buildings.name: Research Station
buildings.effect: Placed next to an anomaly: studies it for research/eureka techs. (Regula I)

buildings.name: Listening Post
buildings.effect: Long-range intel across a border; detects fleet movements in neighboring systems.

buildings.name: Tachyon Detection Node
buildings.effect: Pairs of nodes form a beam line that reveals cloaked ships crossing it.

buildings.name: Self-Replicating Minefield
buildings.effect: Cloaked mines that rebuild themselves; seals a lane/wormhole.

buildings.name: Salvage Station
buildings.effect: Placed at battle sites/derelicts: slow resource + tech-fragment income.
